description: This file defines React components for a modal dialog with enhanced features such as maximization, dynamic content viewing modes (formatted JSON, raw JSON, markdown preview), and integrated UI elements. It includes components DetailedModal and DataModal for displaying content with advanced formatting and interaction options.

methods.name: EnhancedModal
methods.description: React component that renders a modal dialog with optional maximize/restore, close functionalities, and customizable content.

methods.name: DataModal
methods.description: React component that displays data within the EnhancedModal, providing multiple viewing modes (formatted JSON, raw JSON, markdown).
